usedFor: A cancelled Shopify order drafts a cancellation or refund form in ERP Docs.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Document from Template” in ERP Docs
bestTemplate.why: The draft is ready to review, from a template you already have.

watchOut: “Create Document from Template” makes an unsent draft, so nothing reaches the customer until someone sends it.
